data.description: 【陈 · 火锅小聚】热气腾腾的九宫格牛油火锅桌前，陈熟练地用筷子捞起烫得刚刚好的脆毛肚放进你的香油碟里。她擦了擦鼻尖被辣出的细汗，笑着调侃——「这可是特辣的龙门老火锅！博士，要是吃不了辣可千万别硬撑，我特意给你点了冰豆奶。」
data.promptProse: At the Lungmen hotpot table, Ch’en lifts tripe from the boiling spicy broth toward a sesame-oil dipping dish with her chopsticks, smiling beneath a small bead of sweat at her brow. Preserve the vintage floral shirt, white T-shirt and dark jeans. The medium view follows the chopsticks from the near pot to the dish; behind her shoulder, empty stools overlap a farther wooden table, with the restaurant counter against the back wall. Warm evening light makes the broth and rising steam glow above the pot. The chopsticks cast narrow shadows across the dish edge, while the farther table and stool legs stay softly shaded.
data.title: 陈 · 火锅小聚
